bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
stage="$root/.releases/5aff60b6371f422120398212-album-id-stage"
new=create-videobot:album-id-5aff60b6-tested
test -s "$stage/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs" && test -s "$stage/test/album-readback.test.mjs" || exit 61
grep -q 'verifyMembership' "$stage/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs" || exit 62
export GACE_ALBUM_STAGE="$stage"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p=Path(os.environ['GACE_ALBUM_STAGE'])/'test/album-readback.test.mjs'
s=p.read_text()
old='return {listing,store,calls,getVerifiedVideoTopic:async()=>'
new='return {listing,store,calls,verifyMembership:async()=>true,verifyReview:async()=>true,verifyRelease:async()=>true,getVerifiedVideoTopic:async()=>'
if s.count(old)!=1:raise SystemExit(63)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$stage" >/dev/null || exit 64
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs || exit 65
docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/album-readback.test.mjs > "$stage/test-results.log" 2>&1 || exit 66
grep -q 'pass 2' "$stage/test-results.log" || exit 67
grep -q 'fail 0' "$stage/test-results.log" || exit 68
echo VIDEO_ALBUM_ID_STAGE=PASS
echo VIDEO_ALBUM_ID_TESTS=PASS
